# Dual Subtitles Plus for YouTube™

> A Chrome extension that shows two subtitle languages on YouTube at once — the video's own subtitles and YouTube's translation of them — with the translation above the picture and the original below, or both at the bottom.

Published by Greybrown. Runs on youtube.com watch pages only.
No account, no API key, no server; settings stay in the browser.
Permissions: storage; host access to youtube.com only.
Translation is YouTube's own; subtitle languages are whatever YouTube offers for each video.
Interface languages (11): English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Turkish, Vietnamese, Arabic.
Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/): what it does, how it works, privacy, questions
- [Dual subtitles extension not working on YouTube — why, and what to use](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/dual-subtitles-not-working/): why many dual subtitle extensions stopped working on YouTube, what to check, and what to look for in a replacement
- [Privacy policy](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/#privacy): the extension collects nothing
